assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: game animation SPRITE SHEET, not a poster. References: image 1 fixes the adult male character identity; image 2 fixes photographic torn-paper collage style and clothing. The SAME athletic friendly adult man in every frame: curly dark brown hair, light stubble, white sleeveless tank top, green tropical-print shorts, bare feet. Photographic magazine cutouts, irregular visibly fibrous cream paper sticker edges, rich printed grain and subtle halftone, warm summer sunlight. TRUE transparent alpha background between every figure and inside gaps; no scenery, no water, no ground, no shadow, no text, no cell borders. LANDSCAPE sheet, EXACTLY 8 full-body figures in an exact uniform 4 columns by 2 rows grid. Each cell has generous empty margins. Each figure feet end at the same 92% cell height and stays centred, same scale, entire body and hands in frame. View slightly from behind and above, like a chase camera in a surfing game. NO surfboard: the game draws a board separately. NO cup or drink: the right hand must be visible at shoulder/chest height curled in a C-shaped grip around an invisible small mug handle, ready for a separate animated beer prop. Do not swap hands; left arm balances. All frames are steps of ONE surfer's movement, never different characters. Maintain shirt, hair, short pattern and foot positions consistently. Pose sequence in reading order: 1 neutral rear stance with soft knees; 2 weight begins moving onto front foot, shoulders forward slightly; 3 deeper forward trim with lowered knees, right hand still steady; 4 returning upright from forward trim, rear three-quarter view; 5 weight begins shifting onto back foot, chest leans back slightly; 6 deeper rear trim with knees bent and left arm counterbalancing; 7 balanced high-line stance looking left over shoulder, rear three-quarter face visible; 8 same stance with tiny corrective lean to right. These are subtle real surfing weight shifts, not jumps.
